summary: Repeated failed SSH password logins for user-01 on host-01 from ip-01, followed by a successful login from the same address.

sequence.description: ip-01 makes 32 failed SSH password attempts for user-01 on host-01.
ip-01 logs in successfully as user-01 on host-01.

findings.statement: Failed SSH logins for user-01 from ip-01 are followed by a successful login from the same address within four minutes.
The password of user-01 may have been guessed. The evidence does not show what the session did after the login.

weaknesses: SSH password authentication is accepted on host-01 from ip-01.
impact: If the login was not legitimate, the account user-01 on host-01 is under the control of ip-01.
recommendations: Review whether user-01 needs SSH password access to host-01 from outside the network.
risk_justification: Three flagged events form a failure-then-success pattern on one host, which explains the high score.
uncertainty: Only authentication and flow summaries are available; no session or process data shows activity after the login.
